instruction: Change VLC's snapshot filename prefix to 'interstellar-' so future screenshots will have custom names

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC snapshot filename prefix setting. Steps: 1) Open VLC preferences (Tools->Preferences->Show settings: All), 2) Navigate to Video section, 3) Change 'Video snapshot file prefix' from default 'vlc-snap-' to 'interstellar-'. Evaluator reads VLC config file (vlcrc) and checks if snapshot-prefix is set to 'interstellar-'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC snapshot prefix from config file at /home/user/.config/vlc/vlcrc using grep for 'snapshot-prefix=' setting
Metric correctly performs exact string comparison between actual and expected prefix values
Expected value 'interstellar-' matches the instruction requirement exactly
Complete coverage: Single requirement (change prefix to 'interstellar-') is fully verified by the evaluator
Correct parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses expected.get('prefix') where expected IS the rules dict (per framework design)
No postconfig needed: VLC config persists to disk, state is accessible after task completion
Edge cases handled correctly: Missing config file or setting will cause test to fail as expected
